requirement: Import failed reads remain retryable and all seven acceptance defects stay fixed

oracle.ref: PR #1578 (fix); fix evidence: Develop acceptance D1 through D7 from the import error UX report. Each defect has a failing test recorded before its source change.
oracle.invariant: A failed read with no build job permits retry, including correcting the platform; missing, successful, unsupported or unreadable status cannot authorize retry. Concurrent starts and late retries of one failed run share one replacement; S4-F003 never sends a second unknown start. Unknown platform plus Cloudflare preserves both instructions; timeout steps are bullets. Missing admin-form links retain typed source origin, port and subfolder and lead to the platform admin path; unreachable links retain the exact typed URL. Basic password guidance names WordPress or Joomla correctly; the WordPress account error offers Use another account. Basic Auth OFF clears compulsory server fields and the checkbox can be unticked.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: D1: a newly opened wizard retries a failed read only when the claim has no build
D1: after a failed Joomla read, correcting the platform to WordPress permits retry
D1: overlapping starts for one site adopt the same active read
D1: two retries of one failed run start only one replacement even after it has failed
Cloudflare and unknown platform warnings show both instructions in the same resolution
the website timeout gives three bullet steps without an action inside its guidance
missing admin guidance preserves the entered source origin and subfolder safely
server-password guidance names the selected CMS account for both platforms
a WordPress account without installation rights offers Use another account
removing Basic Auth clears required server credentials and leaves the checkbox reversible
